Coffee

What is in the cup and on the plate

From the Google listing and what guests write in their reviews.

Specialty coffee

Single-origin varieties and carefully prepared drinks, as the café describes itself on Google. Guests mention flat white, freddo espresso and cold brew.

Beans to take home

Several kinds of beans are on offer, and guests write they can have them ground. One guest drives in from Limassol just for the beans.

Breakfast and pastries

Breakfast, toasts, sandwiches and pastries. One review mentions homemade breads, butters and jams, another the pistachio croissant.

Tea and juice

Loose-leaf organic teas are available for sale, and guests write about fresh orange juice.

From the café

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews and from the Instagram profile.

They know their coffee

Guests write that the team loves its job and knows a lot about coffee.

Pet friendly

The Instagram profile says pet friendly, and one guest calls it the most important thing for them.

A place to sit and work

Guests say it is a good place to work or study, with fast internet and an easy-going atmosphere.

In Agapinoros

At Agapinoros 8C in Nicosia. Open Monday to Friday from 7:00, on Saturday from 8:00 to 15:00, closed on Sunday.

What guests say

Three of 133 Google reviews, 122 of them with five stars.

“A cozy and warm place with probably the best coffee in Nicosia. They love their job and they know so much about coffee. Delicious and fresh snacks, sandwiches and sweets. The most important for me, it's pet friendly. Highly recommended.”

Google review
“A perfect venue to meet a friend, enjoy a most original taste of coffee and super tasty healthy quality snacks and breakfast. Most importantly, feel the uplifting authenticity of the ambience!”

Google review
